title: Nine Klein LoRA mirrors 404 - the release dep gate is red for all of them
description:
Found 2026-09-01 by MPI-679's verification run, and pre-existing on master. `npm run release:deps` reports NINE dead mirrors besides the foley one: klein-9b-lora-nsfw plus all eight 4B Klein style LoRAs (muppets, cartoon, anime, jojo, chibi, doodle, vintage, aesthetic). Every primary is healthy on R2 - all nine HEAD 200 with a content-length exactly matching the dep's `bytes`, so USERS CAN DOWNLOAD THEM IN THE APP TODAY and nothing is broken in the wild. What is missing is only the failover copy: the generic HF prefix rewrite emits a Mad-Pony-Interactive/cubric-studio path that 404s because the weights were never pushed there, leaving nine deps on a single route - the regression MPI-429's mirror system exists to prevent - and the release gate red for all of them.

NOT a licence question. Licences and credits were settled long before this card: the CivitAI flags are recorded in docs/models/klein/licences.md, the attribution-requiring weights carry `credit` blocks that MpiAbout renders, and MPI-358 covered the sweep. Re-hosting is cleared (Fabio, 2026-09-01). The work is mechanical: 1.09 GB, R2 -> HF, one file at a time, hash-verified both sides, same recipe as MPI-679.

Note for whoever touches klein-9b-lora-nsfw: the comment above it in loraDeps.js says it has no mirrorUrl because CivitAI region-blocks the UK. That reasoning is about CivitAI as a mirror, not about our own HF repo, and it is why the dep also lacks `noMirror: true` - so the rewrite emits a URL that can only 404. Mirroring it to our repo settles both.
